<!-- Simulation Size -->

```{r}
# With a minimum possible coverage of 50% and a desired SE of 0.01, 2500 sims
min_cov <- 0.5
req_se <- 0.01
nsim <- ceiling(min_cov*(1-min_cov)/req_se^2)
nsim
```


<!-- Data Simulation -->

```{r}
set.seed(333)
simulate_data <- function(n, rho) {
  param <- c(1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6, rep(0, 15))
  data <- gen_data(
    n = n,
    p = 20,
    p1 = 5,
    beta = param,
    family = "gaussian",
    corr = "exchangeable",
    rho = rho
  )
  # Name columns x1-x20
  colnames(data$X) <- paste0("x", 1:20)
  data
}
```


<!-- Simulation Parameters -->

```{r}
n_sims <- 2500
p <- 20
n_true <- 5
n_null <- 15
true_ids <- 1:5
null_ids <- 6:20
true_coefs <- c(1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6)
beta_full <- c(true_coefs, rep(0, n_null))  # length-20 true coefficient vector

scenarios <- expand.grid(
  n = c(250, 500),
  rho = c(0, 0.35, 0.70)
)
scenarios$label <- paste0("n=", scenarios$n, ", rho=", scenarios$rho)
n_scenarios <- nrow(scenarios)

methods <- c("backward_pval", "aic", "bic",
             "lasso_min", "lasso_1se",
             "enet_min",  "enet_1se")

# Penalty for backward p-value selection (alpha = 0.05 LRT threshold)
k_pval <- qchisq(0.95, df = 1)   # ~3.84, equivalent to p < 0.05

plan(multisession, workers = 6) # 6 future workers
```


<!-- Selection Functions -->

```{r}
# Backward selection using p-value threshold via LRT penalty
select_backward_pval <- function(X, y) {
  df <- as.data.frame(X)
  df$y <- y
  full_fit <- lm(y ~ ., data = df)
  step_fit <- stepAIC(full_fit, direction = "backward",
                      k = k_pval, trace = FALSE)
  setdiff(names(coef(step_fit)), "(Intercept)")
}

# AIC backward selection (k = 2)
select_aic <- function(X, y) {
  df <- as.data.frame(X)
  df$y <- y
  full_fit <- lm(y ~ ., data = df)
  step_fit <- stepAIC(full_fit, direction = "backward",
                      k = 2, trace = FALSE)
  setdiff(names(coef(step_fit)), "(Intercept)")
}

# BIC backward selection (k = log(n))
select_bic <- function(X, y) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  df <- as.data.frame(X)
  df$y <- y
  full_fit <- lm(y ~ ., data = df)
  step_fit <- stepAIC(full_fit, direction = "backward",
                      k = log(n), trace = FALSE)
  setdiff(names(coef(step_fit)), "(Intercept)")
}

# LASSO: fit once, extract both lambda.min and lambda.1se selections
select_lasso_both <- function(X, y) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
  coefs_min <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")[-1, 1]
  coefs_1se <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.1se")[-1, 1]
  list(
    lasso_min = names(coefs_min)[coefs_min != 0],
    lasso_1se = names(coefs_1se)[coefs_1se != 0]
  )
}

# Elastic net: grid search over alpha; fit once at best alpha, extract both
select_enet_both <- function(X, y) {
  alpha_grid <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)
  best_cvm <- Inf
  best_alpha <- NA

  for (a in alpha_grid) {
    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = a, nfolds = 10)
    if (min(cv_fit$cvm) < best_cvm) {
      best_cvm <- min(cv_fit$cvm)
      best_alpha <- a
    }
  }

  cv_best <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = best_alpha, nfolds = 10)
  coefs_min <- coef(cv_best, s = "lambda.min")[-1, 1]
  coefs_1se <- coef(cv_best, s = "lambda.1se")[-1, 1]
  list(
    enet_min = names(coefs_min)[coefs_min != 0],
    enet_1se = names(coefs_1se)[coefs_1se != 0]
  )
}

# OLS refit on selected variables
refit_ols <- function(X, y, selected) {
  df <- as.data.frame(X[, selected, drop = FALSE])
  df$y <- y
  fit <- lm(y ~ ., data = df)
  ci <- confint(fit, level = 0.95)
  list(
    est = coef(fit)[selected],
    lower = ci[selected, 1],
    upper = ci[selected, 2]
  )
}
```

<!-- Run One Simulation -->

```{r}
run_one_sim <- function(sim, n, rho, p, methods, k_pval, beta_full) {

  dat <- simulate_data(n = n, rho = rho)
  X <- dat$X
  y <- dat$y
  all_vars <- paste0("x", 1:p)

  lasso_sel <- tryCatch(select_lasso_both(X, y),
                        error = function(e) list(lasso_min = character(0),
                                                 lasso_1se = character(0)))
  enet_sel <- tryCatch(select_enet_both(X, y), # zero out errors
                        error = function(e) list(enet_min = character(0),
                                                 enet_1se = character(0))) 
  
  sel_list <- list(
    backward_pval = tryCatch(select_backward_pval(X, y), 
                             error = function(e) character(0)),
    aic = tryCatch(select_aic(X, y), error = function(e) character(0)),
    bic = tryCatch(select_bic(X, y), error = function(e) character(0)),
    lasso_min = lasso_sel$lasso_min,
    lasso_1se = lasso_sel$lasso_1se,
    enet_min = enet_sel$enet_min,
    enet_1se = enet_sel$enet_1se
  )

  # Create per-method result
  result <- vector("list", length(methods))
  names(result) <- methods

  for (m in methods) {
    selected <- sel_list[[m]]
    sel_vec <- setNames(all_vars %in% selected, all_vars)

    ols_est <- ols_lower <- ols_upper <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, p), all_vars) 
    #NA_real_ defaults to numeric type NA rather than logical

    if (length(selected) > 0) {
      ols <- tryCatch(refit_ols(X, y, selected), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(ols)) {
        ols_est[selected] <- ols$est
        ols_lower[selected] <- ols$lower
        ols_upper[selected] <- ols$upper
      }
    }

    result[[m]] <- list(
      selected = sel_vec,
      est = ols_est,
      lower = ols_lower,
      upper = ols_upper
    )
  }

  result
}
```


<!-- Simulation Loop -->

```{r, warning = FALSE}
all_scenario_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)
set.seed(333)

for(s in seq_len(n_scenarios)) {
  n <- scenarios$n[s]
  rho <- scenarios$rho[s]
  cat(sprintf("Scenario %d/%d: %s\n", s, n_scenarios, scenarios$label[s]))

  # Parallel over simulations; future_lapply handles exporting needed objects
  sim_results <- future_lapply(
    seq_len(n_sims),
    run_one_sim,
    n = n, rho = rho, p = p, methods = methods,
    k_pval = k_pval, beta_full = beta_full,
    future.seed = TRUE
  )

  all_scenario_results[[s]] <- sim_results
}
```
<!-- Overall Results -->

```{r}
all_vars <- paste0("x", 1:p)

overall_tpr <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_scenarios, ncol = length(methods),
                      dimnames = list(scenarios$label, methods))
overall_fpr <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_scenarios, ncol = length(methods),
                      dimnames = list(scenarios$label, methods))

# Three-level storage: Scenario, Method, Variable 
var_store <- vector("list", n_scenarios)

for(s in seq_len(n_scenarios)) {
  sim_results <- all_scenario_results[[s]]

  sel_array <- array(
    FALSE,
    dim = c(n_sims, length(methods), p),
    dimnames = list(NULL, methods, all_vars)
  )

  # Initialize storage object
  var_store[[s]] <- vector("list", length(methods))
  names(var_store[[s]]) <- methods
  for(m in methods) {
    var_store[[s]][[m]] <- vector("list", p)
    names(var_store[[s]][[m]]) <- all_vars
    for(v in all_vars) {
      var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]] <- list(
        selected = logical(n_sims),
        est = rep(NA_real_, n_sims),
        lower = rep(NA_real_, n_sims),
        upper = rep(NA_real_, n_sims)
      )
    }
  }

  # Fill from sim_results
  for(sim in seq_len(n_sims)) {
    for(m in methods) {
      r <- sim_results[[sim]][[m]]
      sel_array[sim, m, ] <- r$selected
      for(v in all_vars) {
        var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]]$selected[sim] <- r$selected[v]
        var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]]$est[sim] <- r$est[v]
        var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]]$lower[sim] <- r$lower[v]
        var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]]$upper[sim] <- r$upper[v]
      }
    }
  }

  # TPR and FPR
  true_vars <- paste0("x", true_ids)
  null_vars  <- paste0("x", null_ids)
  for(m in methods) {
    overall_tpr[s, m] <- mean(apply(sel_array[, m, true_vars, drop = FALSE], 
                                     1, all))
    # currently checking to see if ALL X1-X5 included in model = TP
    overall_fpr[s, m] <- mean(apply(sel_array[, m, null_vars, drop = FALSE],
                                     1, any))
    # currently checking to see if ANY X6-X20 included = FP
  }
}
```


<!-- Variable-Level Results -->

```{r}
create_var_summary <- function(var_store, scenarios, methods, beta_full, 
                              true_ids) {
  rows <- list()
  for(s in seq_len(nrow(scenarios))) {
    for(m in methods) {
      for(vi in seq_len(p)) {
        v <- paste0("x", vi)
        vs <- var_store[[s]][[m]][[v]]
        is_true <- vi %in% true_ids
        truth <- beta_full[vi]

        n_total <- length(vs$selected)
        n_sel <- sum(vs$selected)

        if (is_true) { # NA type I error for signal, type 2 error for noise
          type1 <- NA_real_
          type2 <- (n_total - n_sel) / n_total
        } else {
          type1 <- n_sel / n_total
          type2 <- NA_real_
        }

        if (n_sel > 0) {
        # Impute 0 for sims where variable was not selected
          est_all <- ifelse(vs$selected, vs$est, 0)
          low_all <- ifelse(vs$selected, vs$lower, 0)
          upp_all <- ifelse(vs$selected, vs$upper, 0)
          bias <- mean(est_all - truth, na.rm = TRUE)
          coverage <- mean(low_all <= truth & upp_all >= truth, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
        } else {
          bias <- mean(0 - truth)  # = -truth
          coverage <- if (truth == 0) 100 else 0
        }

        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          scenario = scenarios$label[s],
          n = scenarios$n[s],
          rho = scenarios$rho[s],
          method = m,
          variable = v,
          is_true = is_true,
          truth = truth,
          n_selected = n_sel,
          bias = bias,
          coverage = coverage,
          type1 = type1,
          type2 = type2,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

var_summary <- create_var_summary(var_store, scenarios, methods, beta_full, true_ids)
```

<!-- Variable Level Tables -->

```{r}
# Helper functions to make color gradient tables
# low_bad sets direction of "bad" values
make_bg_matrix <- function(mat, low_bad = FALSE,
                            bad_color = "#f28b82",
                            good_color = "#ffffff") {
  vals <- as.vector(mat)
  n_nonmissing <- sum(!is.na(vals))
  rnks <- matrix(
    rank(vals, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min"),
    nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat)
  )
  pct <- rnks / n_nonmissing
  if (low_bad) pct <- 1 - pct
  color_fn <- colorRampPalette(c(good_color, bad_color))
  colors <- color_fn(101)
  matrix(
    colors[round(pct * 100) + 1],
    nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat)
  )
}

make_bg_matrix_absolute <- function(mat, low_bad = FALSE,
                                     bad_color = "#f28b82",
                                     good_color = "#ffffff",
                                     min_val = 0,
                                     max_val = 1) {
  # Clamp to [min_val, max_val] then scale to [0, 1]
  pct <- (mat - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
  pct <- pmax(0, pmin(1, pct))
  if (low_bad) pct <- 1 - pct
  color_fn <- colorRampPalette(c(good_color, bad_color))
  colors <- color_fn(101)
  matrix(
    colors[round(pct * 100) + 1],
    nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat)
  )
}

apply_bg <- function(ft, bg_mat, col_offset = 2) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bg_mat))) {
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(bg_mat))) {
      ft <- bg(ft, i = i, j = j + col_offset,
               bg = bg_mat[i, j], part = "body")
    }
  }
  ft
}

# Helper function to pivot data wider
make_wide_numeric <- function(data, metric_col, method_order) {
  data %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = paste0("x", 1:20))) %>%
    dplyr::select(scenario, variable, method, all_of(metric_col)) %>%
    arrange(scenario, variable) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = all_of(metric_col)) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(method_order)) %>% 
    as.matrix()
}

# Method display names in a fixed order
method_order <- unname(method_labels)

# True preds
true_df <- var_summary %>%
  filter(is_true) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method, !!!method_labels))

# Bias
bias_wide <- make_wide_table(true_df, "bias",
                             fmt_fn = function(x) sprintf("%.4f", x))
bias_num <- make_wide_numeric(true_df, "bias", method_order) %>% abs()
bias_bg  <- make_bg_matrix(bias_num, low_bad = FALSE, bad_color = "#fadedc")
ft_bias  <- flextable(bias_wide) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% fmt_ft() %>%
  apply_bg(bias_bg, col_offset = 2)
ft_bias

# Coverage

                            fmt_fn = function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x))
cov_num <- make_wide_numeric(true_df, "coverage", method_order)
cov_bg  <- make_bg_matrix(cov_num, low_bad = TRUE)  # low = bad
ft_cov  <- flextable(cov_wide) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% fmt_ft() %>%
  apply_bg(cov_bg, col_offset = 2)
ft_cov

# Type II error - cap at 20%
type2_bg <- make_bg_matrix_absolute(type2_num, low_bad = FALSE,
                                     bad_color = "#f28b82",
                                     min_val = 0, max_val = 0.20)

ft_type2 <- flextable(type2_wide) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% fmt_ft() %>%
  apply_bg(type2_bg, col_offset = 2)

# Null preds

  filter(!is_true) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method, !!!method_labels))

# Type I error - floor at 5%, cap at 50% for viz purposes

type1_bg <- make_bg_matrix_absolute(type1_num, low_bad = FALSE,
                                     bad_color = "#f28b82",
                                     min_val = 0.05, max_val = 0.3)
ft_type1   <- flextable(type1_wide) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% fmt_ft() %>%
  apply_bg(type1_bg, col_offset = 2)
```
